**Present to the Committee**

Present your proposal to your classmates in 3-5 minutes. Use at least 10 terms from the glossary during your presentation.

Useful phrases for your presentation:
•	Stating your research question:
My research question is... / I aim to investigate...
•	Formulating a hypothesis
My hypothesis is that... / "I predict that...
•	Explaining falsifiability
This hypothesis is falsifiable because... / We can test it by...
•	Describing methods	
I will use the method of... / My approach involves observation of... / I will conduct an experiment to...
•	Discussing data analysis	
Statistical data processing will help determine... / The results will be analyzed using...
•	Explaining practical importance	
This research could contribute to... / The findings may be used in...
